summary.text: Cody Harris is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 8 who has served since January 8, 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democrat Jeff Chavez is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Cody Harris was born in Tyler, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in December 2006.

His career experience includes working as a ranch broker and operating Liberty Land & Ranch, and he has served as president of the Palestine Young Men's Christian Association and the Palestine Young Professionals Network.
Harris assumed office in the Texas House on January 8, 2019, succeeding Byron Cook.
For 2023-2024 he was assigned to the House Administration, Agriculture and Livestock and Public Education committees and chaired the Local & Consent Calendars Committee.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Harris listed his priorities as securing the border, strengthening public schools, protecting farmers, ranchers and property owner rights, lowering property taxes and shrinking the size of government.
